subject: Pilot runway pause/resume and milestone credits
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina@cobalt.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-team@cobalt.ai
Date: 2025-07-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot runway — short pause request & possible credit approach

Hey Logan,

Quick note from our side: finance has put a short, internal hiring freeze that affects vendor spend for the next 4 weeks. We'd like to avoid ending the pilot with Redwood — the engineering team still needs the timebox — but we also need to pause billing for the pause period.

Two things we'd like to explore:
- Ability to pause the pilot for up to 3 weeks and resume where we left off (KV cache/state preserved).
- If a pause isn't feasible, can Redwood provide milestone-based credits that we draw from while we complete the remaining evaluation work?

We'd also need a brief amendment that clarifies term, billing during pause, and whether seats/accounting can be reallocated while paused.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call later today if that helps.

Thanks,
Nina Patel
Director, ML Infrastructure
Cobalt Analytics

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina@cobalt.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway — short pause request & possible credit approach

Nina — thanks for the heads up and totally understand. We have a couple of pragmatic paths that keep your evaluation intact without restarting engineering work:

Option A — Pause & Resume (preferred):
- We put the pilot into a paused state up to 21 days.
- Billing is suspended for the pause window; after resume we pick up the exact same model/variant and preserve prefix/KV cache for continuity.
- We require a short amendment to the SOW to document dates and a one-time resume fee (nominal) to cover reserved slot rewarm.

Option B — Milestone Credit Ladder:
- If you prefer continuous access, we can issue milestone credits tied to two deliverables (integration smoke test + evaluation report).
- Credits reduce billed usage until exhausted; remaining usage billed normally after credits.

I've attached a light draft amendment (proposed-amendment-v1.pdf) that covers both approaches. Karthik — can you confirm the resume fee and any constraints on seat reallocation while paused?

If that looks ok, we can convert the amendment to a DocuSign for signature today.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-21T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway — short pause request & possible credit approach

Quick note — resume fee: $500 one-time administrative/slot rewarm fee (standard for reserved pilot capacity).
Seat handling: during a pause, we can temporarily reassign up to 2 developer seats to another internal sandbox (no billing change) but persistent production allocations are locked until resume.

If customer wants deeper discounting in lieu of pause, we can offer a 10% credit ladder for milestones but it requires a 60-day conversion window to a committed package.

-Karthik
Head of Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference

From: Nina Patel <nina@cobalt.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-team@cobalt.ai
Date: 2025-07-23T08:54:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway — short pause request & possible credit approach

Thanks Logan/Karthik — this is helpful. A couple of clarifying points from ops: 

- If we take Option A (pause), will the preserved KV cache cover the prefix tokens we've already primed (approx 1.2M tokens)? We can't afford to re-warm that.
- For Option B, can credits be applied to both generation and embeddings usage? Our split is roughly 70/30.

I've attached the team's usage report (Cobalt-usage-report.csv) so you can see the token profile.

If both are doable, we'll likely pick Option A and sign the amendment this week. Alternatively, Option B split-credit would also work if embeddings are supported.

Nina

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina@cobalt.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-24T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway — short pause request & possible credit approach

Nina — good questions and thanks for the usage file. Summary and next steps: 

- KV cache: yes — we support prefix/KV preservation for the 1.2M token primed state under Option A. We'll mark the pilot as "paused-preserve" to guarantee no rewarm.
- Credits: milestone credits can be applied across generation and embeddings; we'll split credits in the same 70/30 ratio you provided.
- Resume fee: confirmed $500 one-time.
- Amendment: attached draft covers both paths; I've updated clause 2.3 to explicitly allow embeddings to draw from milestone credits.

Action plan:
1) I'll publish the amended PDF as a DocuSign today (link: https://www.docusign.com/templates/PAUSE-RESUME-Template) for Nina to sign indicating Option A and the pause window.
2) We put the pilot into paused-preserve state on signature.
3) If anything changes internally at Cobalt, we can convert to Option B within 7 days of signature (no penalty).

Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed-amendment-v1.pdf
